intent: Review the current-proof repair for the Miami Reels hero and caption-styles guide before deployment.

brief.visitor: A person arriving from search or an AI answer who wants help with a Reel.
brief.promise: See current published work before deciding whether to ask Esteban for a quote.
brief.primary_action: Open the current published Reel or start a contact request.
brief.friction: Miami opened with an informational card, and the caption guide still surfaced an owner-rejected older example.

kpi.denominator: Visitors to the two repaired entry pages
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: no source-tagged cohort has been read for this repair
kpi.evidence: Production desktop QA recorded the missing Miami visual and the remaining Bar Door Monkey guide surface.
kpi.readout: T+7 and T+28 after the production release
kpi.decision_rule: Keep the repair only if production remains readable and the existing paths retain measurable inquiry actions.

concept.idea: Reuse one real, current published Reel as proof at the first decision moment.
concept.brand_reason: The homepage and Fort Lauderdale service page already use the same calm proof-card language.
concept.interaction: Existing linked proof card and contact choices.
concept.visible_response: The opening shows an actual project poster and a plainly labelled destination.
concept.direct_path: The existing contact and WhatsApp paths remain unchanged.
concept.alternatives: No new asset, generated image, claim, price, or new funnel component.

story.opening: One current published Reel beside the service answer.
story.action: Inspect the work or choose the existing contact action.
story.consequence: The visitor understands the visual standard before starting a quote conversation.
story.next_step: Continue through the existing scoped contact route.

content.visible: Current Great Reviewer proof, plain service scope and existing starting price.
content.optional_html: Existing native details and guide questions remain server-rendered.
content.linked_depth: Existing Great Reviewer project page, guide details and contact page.

references.borrow: Existing Fort Lauderdale Reels opening and PublishedProjectProof component.
references.avoid: Informational-only hero companion and obsolete human-facing project example.

components.reuse: PublishedProjectProof, guide renderer and delegated analytics attributes.
components.local_reason: No new component is necessary for this two-route repair.

verification.rendered_states: Miami desktop opening; caption guide opening and lower proof block; phone follow-up remains required.
verification.motion: No new motion; current reduced-motion behavior is unchanged.
verification.accessibility_performance: Existing semantic linked proof card and static server HTML are preserved.
verification.raw_html: Confirm Great Reviewer markers and absence of Bar Door Monkey on both localized caption routes.
verification.conversion_boundary: Confirm the visible contact and project destinations return successfully without submitting a lead.
